roadmap.title: Classic story run and chapter objectives
roadmap.description: Play the full campaign on Classic without lowering the setting. Open the Chapter 3 Citrus Farm safe before reading its note, complete each chapter-specific objective, and accumulate combat kills during the Chapter 11 Tonnara shootout.

roadmap.title: Free Ride collectibles and vehicle cleanup
roadmap.description: Use chapter replay for yellow story-only collectibles, clear the remaining map sets in Free Ride, then buy and customize vehicles and finish the speed, jump, and crank objectives.

roadmap.title: Free Ride update activities
roadmap.description: Start Playing with Fire from Enzo’s room, unlock races through Pasquale and Gaspare, and unlock combat challenges through Valerio. Earn at least one medal in every race, Standoff, and Assassination.

achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Prologue — Tremori} to complete its mandatory story milestone.

guide.context: The chapter-ending story flag is automatic; optional objectives do not affect this unlock.

steps.text: Continue Story mode until @loc{Prologue — Tremori} begins.
Complete every mandatory objective in @loc{Prologue — Tremori} and let the ending checkpoint or cutscene register.

achievements.description: Enzo and Isabella’s story came to an end
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Chapter 14 — La Merica} to complete its mandatory story milestone.

guide.context: The chapter-ending story flag is automatic; optional objectives do not affect this unlock.

steps.text: Continue Story mode until @loc{Chapter 14 — La Merica} begins.
Complete every mandatory objective in @loc{Chapter 14 — La Merica} and let the ending checkpoint or cutscene register.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the @item{Praecisione}.

guide.context: The Praecisione is a single-shot sniper rifle that usually kills with one hit. Weapon-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts, and the Tonnara shootout in Chapter 11 supplies enemies and dropped weapons.

steps.text: Pick up or buy the @item{Praecisione} from a wooden weapon crate or a defeated enemy.
During @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}, kill enemies in the Tonnara shootout with the @item{Praecisione}.
Restart the checkpoint after clearing the available enemies and repeat until 20 weapon kills have registered.

achievements.description: Completed the story on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the Prologue and all 14 story chapters on any difficulty.

guide.context: This completion unlocks alongside either difficulty-specific campaign achievement, so a separate easy run is unnecessary.

steps.text: Start Story mode on any available difficulty.
Finish the Prologue and Chapters 1–14 through the ending of @loc{La Merica}.

achievements.description: Completed the story on Hard difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the entire Prologue-through-Chapter 14 campaign on Hard or Classic without lowering the difficulty.

guide.context: The difficulty record covers the whole campaign, so replaying only the finale or raising the setting late does not qualify. A full Classic completion also satisfies the Hard requirement.

steps.text: Start a New Game on @mechanic{Hard} or @mechanic{Classic}.
Do not lower the difficulty at any point from the Prologue through Chapter 14.
Complete @loc{Chapter 14 — La Merica} and let the ending register.

achievements.description: Infiltrate the villa without being seen
achievements.summary: Enter Ludovici’s villa during Chapter 5 without alerting any guard.

guide.context: Silent knockouts are allowed; only an alert invalidates the attempt. The achievement registers at the white interior door, and restarting the checkpoint clears a failed attempt.

steps.text: During @loc{Chapter 5 — Infiltrate Ludovici’s Villa}, pry open the small gate left of the main entrance and pass or knock out the guard.
Take the left uphill path, distract the two talking guards to their right, then climb the ladder into the building.
Leave through the rear wooden door and ignore the two guards beside the car.
Distract the two guards below the villa stairs, sneak behind them, and knock out the lone guard at the top.
Use the villa’s white interior door while every guard remains unaware of Enzo.

achievements.description: Kill Mazzone without alerting his men
achievements.summary: Kill Mazzone during Chapter 13 before any of his guards raise an alert.

guide.context: The requirement begins at the forest-camp objective “Kill Mazzone.” A checkpoint restart resets detection if a guard sees Enzo.

steps.text: At @loc{Chapter 13 — Kill Mazzone}, crouch before entering the forest camp and use Instinct to track guard positions.
Move around the camp’s outer cover and use unseen knife takedowns only when a guard blocks the route.
Reach @enemy{Mazzone} and perform the kill while the camp remains unalerted.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 cars while escaping the Tonnara
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 pursuing cars during the Chapter 11 escape from the Tonnara.

guide.context: Roughly 15–18 enemy vehicles appear during the chase, leaving room for misses. Engine shots destroy vehicles more reliably than shooting their drivers.

steps.text: Reach the vehicle escape near the end of @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}.
Fire continuously into the engines of pursuing enemy cars until each vehicle explodes or becomes disabled.
Destroy 10 enemy cars before the Tonnara chase ends.

achievements.summary: Complete the optional garden meeting with Isabella at the start of Chapter 3.

guide.context: The meeting is available only before reporting to Luca at the stables; its white diamond is an optional-objective marker rather than the main-story cross.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Chapter 3 — Pizzu}, receive Isabella’s invitation while the objective says “Meet Luca at the Stables.”
Follow the white optional-objective marker to the garden before going to Luca.
Enter the garden and finish the cutscene with @npc{Isabella}.

achievements.description: Defeat Don Torrisi without taking a single hit
achievements.summary: Win the Chapter 14 knife fight against Don Torrisi without taking damage.

guide.context: Only damage during the mandatory knife duel counts; shots taken in the preceding mine sequence do not matter. The duel has checkpoints, and restarting after a hit preserves eligibility.

steps.text: Reach the mandatory fight with @enemy{Don Torrisi} after “Get to Isabella” in @loc{Chapter 14 — La Merica}.
Use stabs while Torrisi is open, break his guard when he blocks, and dodge backward instead of risking a timed block.
Restart the latest checkpoint immediately after taking any duel damage.
Complete the knife fight with no damage recorded in its current checkpoint segments.

achievements.description: Complete the race in under 8 minutes
achievements.summary: Finish the six-car race in Chapter 7 in less than 8:00.

guide.context: The limit is generous compared with a normal winning run, and race checkpoints allow recovery from a major crash without restarting the entire event.

steps.text: Reach “Win the race” in @loc{Chapter 7 — Spirito Sportivo}.
Drive the marked course, use safe grass shortcuts where available, and avoid prolonged crashes.
Cross the finish line in first place before the timer reaches 8:00.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the @item{Lupara}.

guide.context: The Lupara is a two-shot sawed-off shotgun that occupies the handgun slot. Weapon-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts, and the Tonnara shootout in Chapter 11 supplies enemies and dropped weapons.

steps.text: Pick up or buy the @item{Lupara} from a wooden weapon crate or a defeated enemy.
During @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}, kill enemies in the Tonnara shootout with the @item{Lupara}.
Restart the checkpoint after clearing the available enemies and repeat until 20 weapon kills have registered.

achievements.description: Killed 20 enemies with a Pump-Action Shotgun
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the @item{Pump-Action Shotgun}.

guide.context: The Pump-Action is the five-shell shotgun and fires faster than the other shotguns. Weapon-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts, and the Tonnara shootout in Chapter 11 supplies enemies and dropped weapons.

steps.text: Pick up or buy the @item{Pump-Action Shotgun} from a wooden weapon crate or a defeated enemy.
During @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}, kill enemies in the Tonnara shootout with the @item{Pump-Action Shotgun}.
Restart the checkpoint after clearing the available enemies and repeat until 20 weapon kills have registered.

achievements.description: Kill Caccini before he reaches the Salt Flats
achievements.summary: Destroy Caccini’s escape car and kill him before he reaches the Salt Flats in Chapter 13.

guide.context: Caccini’s car is already parked in the combat area, so sabotaging it before dealing with his men prevents the chase from starting.

steps.text: After killing Mazzone in @loc{Chapter 13 — Capiregime}, ride to Cesare until the objective changes to “Kill Caccini.”
Ignore the gunmen, move left to the two parked cars, and destroy the farther car on the left.
Clear or bypass the remaining enemies, then kill @enemy{Caccini} beside his disabled car.

achievements.summary: Buy the 1,000-Dinari paint unlock at Pasquale’s Store and equip any car style in a garage.

guide.context: Vehicle customization becomes practical after Chapter 4. The paint can permanently unlocks the Styles tab for every owned car.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Pasquale’s Store} west of Villa Torrisi and buy the spray can from the vehicle table for 1,000 Dinari.
Use the garage outside Pasquale’s Store or any other garage and select an owned car.
Switch to @mechanic{Styles} and equip any color.

achievements.summary: Collect any one Mystery Fox statue in Story mode or Free Ride.

guide.context: Mystery Foxes save immediately when collected. Ten appear only inside story chapters, while the other 40 can be reached in Free Ride.

steps.text: Approach any Mystery Fox icon in a chapter or Free Ride and search the marked area for the fox statue.
Interact with the @item{Mystery Fox} statue and wait for the collection notification.

achievements.summary: Equip any horse accessory when the stable customization menu opens in Chapter 4.

guide.context: Horse customization first becomes available while Enzo walks with Isabella to the stables at the start of Chapter 4.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Chapter 4 — Il Barone}, walk with Isabella to the stables.
Choose any available horse and switch to the @mechanic{Accessories} tab.
Equip any owned horse outfit or accessory; buy a 200-Dinari option first if none is owned.

achievements.summary: Beat the train to the endpoint during Chapter 7’s race-car test.

guide.context: This is the “Race the train” objective before the chapter’s main race. A crash can be erased by restarting its checkpoint.

steps.text: Begin “Race the train” in @loc{Chapter 7 — Spirito Sportivo}.
Keep the race car at full acceleration, follow the marked route, and avoid collisions.
Cross the test-course finish line before the train arrives.

achievements.description: Performed all Special Actions 5 times with each knife
achievements.summary: Perform five Scannaturi knife throws and five Rasolu combat takedowns.

guide.context: The wording is misleading: Stiletto knives have no combat Special Action, so only one Scannaturi and one Rasolu are needed. Each use consumes sharpness, while checkpoint restarts preserve progress.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 5 — Infiltrate Ludovici’s Villa}, use the knife box beside Tino before entering the grounds.
Equip any @item{Scannaturi}, kill five enemies with its thrown-knife Special Action, and replenish sharpness as needed.
Restart the checkpoint, equip any @item{Rasolu}, and perform its combat-takedown Special Action on five enemies.

achievements.summary: Open the Charms menu and equip any Charm, including Sant’Agata from Chapter 1.

guide.context: The first guaranteed Charm is beside the bathtub in Enzo’s room near the end of Chapter 1, after Cesare tells him to clean up.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 1 — Famiglia}, collect @item{Sant’Agata} from the table beside the bathtub in Enzo’s room.
Open the pause menu, select @mechanic{Charms}, and place Sant’Agata or another Charm into an empty slot.

achievements.summary: Collect any Trinacria coin, such as the coin on the left route through Chapter 3’s warehouse.

guide.context: Only one coin is required; Trinacria coins are common valuables and are separate from the four sets required for the full collection.

steps.text: During the Chapter 3 warehouse infiltration, take the left-hand route through the guarded area.
Search the route’s interactable pickups and collect a @item{Trinacria coin}.

achievements.description: Refuse to carry out an execution
achievements.summary: When Tino orders an execution in Chapter 5 or Chapter 13, do not attack the captive.

guide.context: Chapter 5 is the earliest opportunity. The deliberate refusal may lead to a failure scene, but the achievement registers before the checkpoint is reloaded.

steps.text: Reach the captured Ludovici scene near the end of @loc{Chapter 5 — Vendetta D’onore}.
When @npc{Tino} orders Enzo to execute Ludovici, do not press the attack or fire controls.
Remain idle until the scene resolves and the achievement registers.

achievements.summary: Collect any Newspaper, such as the copy available before dinner in Chapter 1.

guide.context: There are 50 Newspapers, and every copy also contributes to The Collector. Collected issues save immediately.

steps.text: Before dinner in @loc{Chapter 1 — Famiglia}, search the accessible rooms for the highlighted Newspaper pickup.
Interact with the @item{Newspaper} and wait for the collection notification.

achievements.description: Reach the foreman’s office without being seen
achievements.summary: Reach the foreman’s office in Chapter 9 without triggering an enemy alert.

guide.context: The stealth condition applies to the approach during Chapter 9’s factory infiltration. Restarting the checkpoint after detection resets the attempt.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 9 — Industria}, crouch when the objective directs Enzo toward the foreman’s office.
Use cover, distractions, and unseen takedowns to pass every guard without filling the alert indicator.
Enter the foreman’s office while the guards remain unaware.

achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with grenades or other explosive damage.

guide.context: Explosive-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts. Chapter 11’s Tonnara shootout provides dense enemy groups and resupply opportunities.

steps.text: Loot grenades and explosive supplies before or during the Tonnara shootout in @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}.
Throw explosives into clustered enemies and confirm that the blast, rather than gunfire, delivers the killing damage.
Restart the checkpoint and repeat until 10 explosive kills register.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the @item{Vendetti}.

guide.context: The Vendetti is the powerful four-round pistol. Weapon-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts, and the Tonnara shootout in Chapter 11 supplies enemies and dropped weapons.

steps.text: Pick up or buy the @item{Vendetti} from a wooden weapon crate or a defeated enemy.
During @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}, kill enemies in the Tonnara shootout with the @item{Vendetti}.
Restart the checkpoint after clearing the available enemies and repeat until 20 weapon kills have registered.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 unaware enemies with immediate one-hit knife takedowns from behind.

guide.context: Grappling an enemy first or slashing during open combat does not count. The knife needs a sharpness charge for the qualifying instant takedown.

steps.text: Crouch behind an unaware enemy while carrying a sharpened knife.
Press the takedown control immediately from behind to perform the one-hit knife execution.
Repeat on 20 enemies; use a stealth-heavy chapter checkpoint if cleanup is needed.

achievements.description: Killed 20 enemies with a Modello C96
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the @item{Modello C96}.

guide.context: The Modello C96 is the fast-firing nine-round pistol. Weapon-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts, and the Tonnara shootout in Chapter 11 supplies enemies and dropped weapons.

steps.text: Pick up or buy the @item{Modello C96} from a wooden weapon crate or a defeated enemy.
During @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}, kill enemies in the Tonnara shootout with the @item{Modello C96}.
Restart the checkpoint after clearing the available enemies and repeat until 20 weapon kills have registered.

achievements.summary: Kill enemies with 30 headshots using any firearm.

guide.context: Any gun counts, and headshot progress persists through checkpoint restarts, making the Chapter 11 shootout a quick cleanup spot.

steps.text: Use cover and aim at an enemy’s head until the reticle is centered.
Fire and confirm that the headshot kills the enemy.
Repeat for 30 headshot kills, restarting a dense combat checkpoint if needed.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the @item{Repeater}.

guide.context: The Repeater is the fast-firing seven-round rifle. Weapon-kill progress persists through checkpoint restarts, and the Tonnara shootout in Chapter 11 supplies enemies and dropped weapons.

steps.text: Pick up or buy the @item{Repeater} from a wooden weapon crate or a defeated enemy.
During @loc{Chapter 11 — Mattanza}, kill enemies in the Tonnara shootout with the @item{Repeater}.
Restart the checkpoint after clearing the available enemies and repeat until 20 weapon kills have registered.

achievements.description: Cracked a safe without a combination
achievements.summary: Open Chapter 3’s Citrus Farm safe with 10-20-30 before reading its combination note.

guide.context: Combination notes remain known across chapter replay, so reading every safe note can remove the cleanest opportunity from the current save. The dial’s heavier click also reveals each correct number without a note.

steps.text: During @loc{Chapter 3 — Collect the money}, enter the Citrus Farm room containing the mandatory safe.
Do not pick up or read the nearby note that contains the safe combination.
Turn the safe dial to @mechanic{10-20-30} and open the safe.

achievements.summary: Collect all 50 Mystery Fox statues across the story chapters and Free Ride.

guide.context: Ten foxes are chapter-exclusive and appear as yellow replay icons; the other 40 are available in Free Ride. Nearby collectibles reveal themselves on the map, and each pickup saves immediately.

steps.text: Use the yellow chapter-replay icons to collect the 10 Mystery Foxes located inside story missions.
Enter Free Ride from the main menu and explore every Mystery Fox icon revealed while traveling through Valle Dorata.
Collect the remaining statues until the Mystery Fox counter reaches 50/50.

achievements.summary: Collect all 50 Mystery Foxes, 50 Newspapers, 23 Photographs, and 20 Saints’ Cards.

guide.context: The Collection menu covers the three document sets, but this achievement also requires every Mystery Fox, for 143 pickups total. Story-only items appear as yellow chapter-replay icons, and collection progress carries back to Free Ride.

steps.text: Collect every yellow story-only pickup through chapter replay: 10 Mystery Foxes, 10 Newspapers, 3 Photographs, and 2 Saints’ Cards.
In Free Ride, explore near collectible icons and collect the remaining 40 Mystery Foxes, 40 Newspapers, 20 Photographs, and 18 Saints’ Cards.
Confirm totals of 50 Mystery Foxes, 50 Newspapers, 23 Photographs, and 20 Saints’ Cards.

achievements.description: Fixed a broken vehicle by using the crank
achievements.summary: Damage one of Enzo’s cars until its engine burns, then restart it with the front crank.

guide.context: Free Ride is the safest setting because disabling the car does not interfere with a story objective.

steps.text: Enter Free Ride and take any owned car from a garage.
Leave the car, shoot its engine until flames and black smoke show that the vehicle is disabled.
Approach the front of the disabled car and use the interaction prompt to turn the crank.

achievements.summary: Launch the Carozella Mark 2 from the rail-side ramp near Pasquale’s Gas Station and travel over 40 meters.

guide.context: The Chapter 7 race car is fast enough without upgrades. A long, straight approach matters more than landing cleanly.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Pasquale’s Gas Station} as the Free Ride travel destination, then take the @item{Carozella Mark 2} from its garage.
Drive onto the train tracks in front of the garage, turn right, and follow the tracks to the first ramp a few hundred meters away.
Build maximum speed on the approach and launch from the ramp without braking.

achievements.description: Bought all available cars from Pasquale
achievements.summary: After Chapter 7, spend 11,000 Dinari to buy all seven cars sold by Pasquale.

guide.context: Only purchasable cars count; story rewards do not. The seven prices are 1,000, 1,000, 1,500, 1,500, 1,500, 2,000, and 2,500 Dinari.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Chapter 7 — Spirito Sportivo} so Pasquale’s full vehicle stock is available.
If needed, open the two blue chests in Chapter 7’s starting room, restart the checkpoint, and repeat until Enzo has 11,000 Dinari.
At any garage, buy Dufort 30, Beneventi 24HP, Eckhart Dominion, Trautenberg Sport-Renner, Dufort Camionette, Trautenberg 3600TF, and Delizia Type 86.

achievements.description: Drove at 120 km/h for at least 15 seconds
achievements.summary: Maintain at least 120 km/h for 15 continuous seconds in the Carozella Mark 2.

guide.context: The Chapter 7 Carozella Mark 2 reaches 162 km/h. The northeast road from Porto Almaro provides enough uninterrupted distance in Free Ride.

steps.text: After Chapter 7, enter Free Ride and select the @item{Carozella Mark 2}.
Fast-travel to @loc{Porto Almaro} and take the long road leading northeast.
Accelerate past 120 km/h and remain above that speed without collision or braking for at least 15 seconds.

achievements.description: Completed the story on Classic difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the Prologue and all 14 chapters on Classic without lowering the difficulty.

guide.context: Classic increases combat, stealth, and driving difficulty, limits health regeneration, reduces HUD assistance, and applies more realistic vehicle handling and ammunition looting.

steps.text: Start a New Game and select @mechanic{Classic} difficulty.
Keep Classic selected for the entire Prologue-through-Chapter 14 campaign.
Finish @loc{Chapter 14 — La Merica} and let the ending register.

achievements.summary: Collect all 14 Playing with Fire documents in Free Ride, beginning with Benedetta’s Letter in Enzo’s room.

guide.context: Playing with Fire is a treasure-hunt chain: the first letter starts the activity, and each recovered clue directs Enzo toward the next hidden document.

steps.text: Enter Free Ride, go to Enzo’s room, and collect @item{Benedetta’s Letter} from the table.
Read each Playing with Fire clue, travel to the pictured or described place in Valle Dorata, and collect the document hidden there.
Continue the clue chain until all 14 Playing with Fire documents have been collected and the activity completes.

achievements.description: Completed all Races, earning at least a medal in each.
achievements.summary: Earn at least a bronze medal in all 15 Free Ride races: 3 Circuit, 3 Road Sprint, 6 Time Trial, and 3 Horse Race events.

guide.context: Pasquale starts the car-race chain and Gaspare starts the horse-race chain. Events appear as story progress permits, and later challenges unlock in sequence.

steps.text: After completing Chapter 2, enter Free Ride and speak with @npc{Pasquale} for car races and @npc{Gaspare} for horse races.
Earn any medal in all 3 Circuit Races, 3 Road Sprints, and 6 Time Trials.
Earn any medal in all 3 Horse Races by managing spur stamina and staying on the marked course.
Confirm that every one of the 15 race icons shows at least one medal.

achievements.description: Completed all Standoffs, earning at least a medal in each.
achievements.summary: Finish all four waves and score at least 15,000 points in each of the five Free Ride Standoffs.

guide.context: Valerio unlocks combat challenges at Villa Torrisi. High-value enemies carry stopwatch pickups that add 15 seconds, while rapid kills build the score multiplier needed for a medal.

steps.text: Enter Free Ride, fast-travel to @loc{Villa Torrisi}, and speak with @npc{Valerio} in the adjacent weapons room.
Start each Standoff, keep moving between enemy spawns, and defeat all four waves before time expires.
Loot every fallen enemy marked with a stopwatch to add 15 seconds and chain quick kills to maintain the score multiplier.
Reach at least 15,000 points in each of the five Standoffs so every event awards a medal.

achievements.description: Completed all Assassinations, earning at least a medal in each.
achievements.summary: Kill each designated assassination target, reach the exit, and earn at least bronze in all four Free Ride Assassinations.

guide.context: Valerio unlocks the Assassination chain at Villa Torrisi. Cracking optional safes improves the score, but a qualifying completion is built around identifying the target, killing him, and escaping alive.

steps.text: Enter Free Ride, fast-travel to @loc{Villa Torrisi}, and speak with @npc{Valerio} in the weapons room.
In each Assassination, stay unseen where possible, identify the marked target, and kill him before the timer expires.
After the target dies, follow the exit marker and leave the challenge area alive.
Complete all four Assassinations with at least one medal shown on every event icon.
